representation: Graph of f(x) = x^3/3 - x with a movable point, a tangent line through it, and a pulsing ring marking the point where the slope is read.
entities: eight line segments approximating the cubic on -2.4..2.4
tangent line through the point with screen slope -(55/90) f'(x)
motion: Point and tangent are expression-driven by the xp slider so they move together; the ring radius pulses 16 -> 22 -> 16 on the timeline as a non-essential emphasis.
checkpoints: 0.2 s: height and slope are different numbers
2 s: at x near 1 the tangent is flat but f is about -0.67
3.6 s: at x = 1.5 the curve rises while f is negative
5.2 s: at x = -0.5 the curve falls while f is positive
6.8 s: slope zero at x = -1 and x = 1, curve smooth everywhere shown
misconceptionTest: Checkpoint 2 shows f'(1) = 0 with f(1) != 0, attacking 'derivative is the value'. Checkpoint 3 shows f'(1.5) = 1.25 > 0 with f(1.5) = -0.375 < 0, attacking 'positive derivative means positive function'. The sign is also stated in words, not by colour.
accessibility: Alt text describes curve, point and tangent; slider is keyboard operable; slope sign is stated in checkpoint text as well as shown by tilt; reducedMotion static.
